question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The mothers, who suffer from postpartum depression, feel ______ by their children. (vexed)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vexed"** means feeling annoyed, frustrated, or worried. (परेशान)
 
 
• **Example:** She was vexed by the constant noise coming from the construction site.
 
 
 
• **"Annoyed"** refers to feeling slightly angry or irritated. (चिढ़)
 
 
• **Example:** He was annoyed by the repeated interruptions during his presentation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'vexed'** is **'annoyed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delighted** (प्रसन्न): Feeling or showing great pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** She was delighted to receive the award.
 
 
 
• **Recovered** (सुधार): To return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** He has recovered from his illness and is back to work.
 
 
 
• **Pacific** (शांतिपूर्ण): Peaceful in character or intent.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a pacific nature and always tries to avoid conflicts.
